title: Power BI to Fabric Migration
summary: A strategic and technical playbook for moving a Power BI Premium or Pro estate to Microsoft Fabric: capacity migration, rationalization, medallion rebuild, validation, go-live and adoption.
audience: Platform leads, architects, BI and data engineers, program managers

pages.title: Overview and execution map
pages.description: Why the migration has two workstreams, the four execution phases, and how the pages of this playbook fit together.

pages.title: Strategy, licensing and capacity
pages.description: Strategic case, migration paths, F SKU licensing rules, cost levers, smoothing and throttling, and the Premium-to-Fabric capacity runbook.

pages.title: Architecture and environments
pages.description: Medallion layers, All-Lakehouse versus Hybrid decision matrix, workspace strategy, naming convention, Git and CI/CD foundation.

pages.title: Governance with Fabric and Purview
pages.description: A govern-first framework: OneLake catalog, domains, endorsement, sensitivity labels, DLP, audit and access control.

pages.title: Assessment and rationalization
pages.description: Automated inventory, usage analysis within activity-log retention limits, the decision tree and the report rationalization matrix template.

pages.title: Reverse-engineering legacy assets
pages.description: Extract models, DAX, M, security and query patterns with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Semantic Link, BPA and PBIP/TMDL; write the specification and mapping documents.

pages.title: Build the data layers
pages.description: Medallion build guidance for a Power BI migration, replacing Dataflow Gen1, Warehouse SCD Type 2 pattern, and metadata-driven orchestration.

pages.title: Semantic models and reports
pages.description: Choose Import, Direct Lake or DirectQuery, rebuild certified semantic models and thin reports, rebind keepers, and migrate security.

pages.title: Validate, deploy and go live
pages.description: Data reconciliation, functional, performance and security QA, UAT, production deployment, parallel run and decommissioning.

pages.title: Change, support and project plan
pages.description: Communication and training plan, post-migration support model, a phased project plan template with a relative-week timeline, and checklists.
